approved_payload.content: Road infrastructure on Nasrec Road in Riverlea, Johannesburg, collapsed on Wednesday 25 November after heavy rain, leaving a large hole, The Bulrushes reports. JMPD spokesperson Superintendent Xolani Fihla said the Johannesburg Roads Agency had closed Nasrec Road between Main Reef Road and Dunlin Drive and that it will stay closed until JRA engineers have assessed and repaired the damage; northbound traffic is blocked at Dunlin Drive, and detours are Crownwood Road, New Canada Road, Colorado Drive and Avon Street. South African Daily carries the same JMPD account. No injuries were reported in either report. The pin is approximate: the Nasrec Road point near Dunlin Drive, not the collapse itself, which the reports do not place more exactly.
